ablation_semantics.dual_level: target/global memories with target prompt disabled
ablation_semantics.uniform_prompt_fusion: target/global memories with uniform source-prompt fusion and no support adaptation
ablation_semantics.rc_memnet: shared persistent memory with support-adapted source-prompt fusion
ablation_semantics.no_context_prompt: remove learned context prompts from source and target encoding
ablation_semantics.no_memory_adapter: remove memory read/write adaptation and keep prompt-conditioned encoder
ablation_semantics.no_prompt_no_memory: remove both context prompts and memory adaptation
ablation_semantics.no_slow_consolidation: full PCLR without slow global-memory consolidation
ablation_semantics.full_pclr: full PCLR with prompt routing, gated adaptation, and slow consolidation
